note: BLACKLIST (https://playblacklist.com/) is capture-class: a Unity 6 WebGL game (loader/data/framework/wasm plus StreamingAssets asset bundles) behind a small hand-written site (js/*.js, css/*.css). §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-13 — neither the page nor any captured JS references a public source repo (zero github.com/gitlab.com references in the capture; the repo-shaped strings are backend API paths only), so the mirror stands. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, formatted to a fixed point — ≤6 passes, prettier 3.9.6 is not idempotent on every input and two site scripts settle on the 3rd pass; never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/<name>.pretty.js per captured JS file (capture-relative name, nested dirs flattened with __; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/<name>-NN.js of every APP script (top-level declaration boundaries only, ~250-350 line windows; oversized single declarations stay whole) with an exact 2-line provenance header. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range. Unity build rule (README): the Unity loader (game/Build/game.loader.js) and the Unity engine framework (game/Build/game.framework.js.br, stored browser-decoded under a .br name) are vendor glue — wholeFile sections, never sliced; the game logic ships compiled inside game.data.br/game.wasm.br and all asset bundles, which are hashed notRendered records, never rendered. Inline <script>/<style> scan: index.html and leaderboard/index.html carry the 105-byte prelaunch gate — twins readable/<page>-inline-N.pretty.js + readable/inline-map.json with byte ranges + sha256. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
